newsitem.title: USA: National City to boost stake in National Processing.
newsitem.headline: National City to boost stake in National Processing.

text.p: National City Corp., a financial services company, said Friday it plans to buy up to 2 million more shares of National Processing Inc., increasing its stake to about 89 percent from 85 percent.
National Processing's stock shot up $1.625, about 23 percent to $8.625, making it the top gainer early on the New York Stock Exchange.
National City, based in Cleveland, owns 43.1 million of National Processing's 50.6 million shares outstanding.
National Processing, which processes card and check transactions for merchants, sold a stake of about 12 percent in its August 1996 initial public offering of 6.5 million shares at $16.50 apiece.
National Processing, also based in Cleveland, provides administrative and financial functions, and ticket processing and settlement for travel agents.
National City, with assets of $50 billion, operates banks and other financial services subsidiaries primarily in Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana and Pennsylvania.
National City's stock rose 25 cents to $49.375 also on the NYSE.
